Update firmware

Motorcontrol Desktop

Use the same dashboards with native USB on macOS (Apple silicon) or Windows (x64). For a supported NEMA17 controller, stop motion, disconnect PWR, and leave only its DATA cable attached. In the desktop Firmware tab, choose Identify controller, check the proposed version, then select Install firmware. Keep DATA attached until the app verifies the restarted board.

Motorcontrol Desktop releases and signed downloads

Manual installation and recovery

For the NEMA17 DRV8825 with PD sensing (firmware board ID rp2040_drv8825_pd), the 1.0.23 PD firmware image and its source and hardware validation notes are available separately. Use the image for your exact board profile.

RP2040 / MCT8329A BLDC: download the BLDC UF2 for Single BLDC control. This is a separate target from the stepper firmware below.

Current required version: 1.0.17. Each connected controller shows its running version and build. ⚠ means an older or unverified version. Updating is optional for connecting; it does not block controls.

  1. Open firmware builds. Choose a successful build from the same branch as this site (main for production).
  2. Under Artifacts, download the matching board image: motorcontrol-rp2040-nema23_drv8452 for NEMA23, motorcontrol-rp2040-drv8825 for NEMA17 PCB 1.0.42, motorcontrol-rp2040-nema17_drv8847 for older NEMA17 boards, or motorcontrol-rp2040-nema14_a4988 for NEMA14/A4988 PCB 1.13.2. Unzip it. GitHub sign-in may be needed.
  3. Stop motion, disconnect the dashboard and unplug motor power. For responsive native stepper firmware, use a 115200-baud terminal on DATA and send {"cmd":"bootloader"} followed by a newline. If the board is unresponsive, hold BOOTSEL while reconnecting DATA.
  4. Copy motorcontrol.uf2 onto the RPI-RP2 drive in Finder or your file manager. The board restarts automatically.
  5. Reconnect on the site and check the displayed version. Update each controller separately.

There is currently no browser flashing button; the browser downloads the firmware and your file manager copies it to the board.
